action.command:
cd /workspace && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c "from reducer import empty_state,apply_event; from checkpoint import dump_state,load_state; from codec import parse_event
s=empty_state(); s=apply_event(s,parse_event('{\"id\":\"e1\",\"op\":\"restock\",\"sku\":\"A\",\"qty\":5}'))
t=dump_state(s); print(repr(t)); print('seen in dump:', '\"seen\"' in t and 'e1' in t)
l=load_state(t); print('seen preserved:', l['seen']==s['seen'])"
